title: Overprint
tagline: Turn and restack the punched cards until every row reads a word.
description: Printer robots punched holes in cards that sit over a letter grid, and you see the top printed letter in each square. Turn the cards and change their order until every row is a real word, then press it into print. Two solver-checked sheets a day with streaks, a 60-sheet Journey and free play.
difficultyNote: The Small sheet is a quick read; the Large sheet's fourth card makes you think.
coverAlt: Illustration: printer robots with mismatched eyes stack punched paper cards over a letter grid, ink splats and stamped words on cream paper.
